interpretation: Descriptive audit. Gaps can arise from different base rates even when sensitive attributes are excluded from the model (proxies). Review groups with equal_opportunity_gap > 0.15 or selection_rate_ratio < 0.8 (four-fifths rule) before deployment. gap_null is the gap that random group labels give at the same group sizes; a gap inside it is not evidence of a group difference. threshold_review is for policy review only: group-specific cut-offs would use a sensitive attribute at decision time, so they are not applied.
